motion_registers.announcer: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Phosphor bloom breathes gently. Rainbow planes drift and fold inward. Dial light echoes recursively. Slow sculptural push forward.
motion_registers.music_open: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial sweep blooms into red blue green halos. Nested feedback reflections unfold softly. Color layers drift apart. Measured push forward.
motion_registers.music_close: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial settles. Prismatic halos contract softly. Layered color planes dim to charcoal. Slow pull back.
motion_registers.music_inter: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial steady, glowing. Waveform light breathes across the surface. Translucent planes orbit slowly around the speaker.
